<!-- version: 2.51.2 -->
A documentation-only release. Nothing in the app itself has changed since 2.51.1, and there is nothing to do by hand after the update.

The project's internal specification now records three calendar behaviours it had been missing. If you are running 2.51.1, you already have everything this version does.

Full release notes are available at https://github.com/ulsklyc/yuvomi/releases/tag/v2.51.2
